title: A named redaction travels in 'consumer-session/create' as 'config.redaction', as written.
why: behavioural spec 'janus': when the options name a redaction, 'consumer-session/create' carries it as 'config.redaction', as written. The SDK parses no path and redacts nothing itself: which members carry credentials is the transport's to declare, and redacting them the engine's (ADR 0074).
note: The paths are spelled as a user would, one with a capital, one quoted: an SDK that normalised either would send something else.
